## Overview

`aviculture` simulates an age-mass structured poultry farm model with healthy
and growth-stunted chickens. The package provides a PDE solver, indicator
tables, two-dimensional graphics, supply optimization, and sensitivity
analysis.

## Basic workflow

```{r}
library(aviculture)

grid <- create_grid(t_max = 14, a_max = 14, m_max = 1.5, h_t = 0.5, h_m = 0.1)
parameters <- create_parameters()
controls <- create_controls(grid = grid)

simulation <- solve_aviculture(
  grid = grid,
  parameters = parameters,
  controls = controls,
  store_states = TRUE
)

head(compute_indicators(simulation))
compute_objectives(simulation)
```

## Two-dimensional plots

```{r, eval = FALSE}
plot_population(simulation, overlay = FALSE)
plot_economics(simulation, overlay = FALSE)
plot_demand(simulation)
plot_heatmap(simulation, variable = "healthy", time = 10)
```

## Sensitivity analysis

```{r}
sensitivity <- run_sensitivity(
  grid = grid,
  parameters = parameters,
  controls = controls,
  variables = c("rho", "gamma_scale", "supply_scale"),
  values = c(0.8, 1, 1.2)
)

head(sensitivity$results)
```

## Optimization

```{r, eval = FALSE}
optimized <- optimize_supply(
  grid = grid,
  parameters = parameters,
  controls = controls,
  objective = "J2",
  blocks = 4
)

summary(optimized$simulation)
```
